rules: Betazoids are externally very Human-like; dark/black iris presentation is a recurring full-Betazoid species cue.
Telepathy has no automatic visible glow, aura or eye effect.
Broad humanlike variation in skin tone, facial structure, hair and body type remains available.
Hybrid ancestry may alter visible traits and must resolve from the actual lineage profile rather than this full-Betazoid default.
forbidden_variation: telepathic visual effects without an explicit scene effect
notes: Capability strength and privacy norms are gameplay state, not visible morphology.
